correctness.rationale: In actual RESULT.md, orthogonality fixes E[h]=0 and E[h Q_n]=binom(n,2) for every representative; the median minimizes E|Q_n-c|, giving a dual lower bound. A sign-of-Q-minus-median function with exact tie mass correction has mean zero, symmetry kills degree-one coefficients and equates all degree-two coefficients. Since E[hQ_n]=binom(n,2), each degree-two coefficient is exactly 1; it attains the bound. Median convergence follows CLT for S_n/sqrt(n); fourth-moment uniform integrability yields E|Q_n-m|/n -> 2a phi(a), yielding stated constant. Verified source checker.py logical exact Fraction implementation and separately brute-checked every Walsh coefficient of the optimizer for n=2..8 in independent_checks.py. Finite checks corroborate, not replace proof.
correctness.residual_risks: Real scalar functions only; complete symmetric quadratic Walsh element, not arbitrary quadratic coefficient tensors or complex-valued quotient; first-order asymptotic only; full priority unproven.
